description: Complete lines that may differ between project-template/.claude/commands/start.md and project-template/.cursor/commands/start.md. /sync check cursor-start-parity waives a line only when it equals one entry. A phrase inside a longer line waives nothing, and one entry waives one line. These entries cannot waive a forbidden step (Proposed, hand-editing rendered views, or creating the session log by copying SESSION_TEMPLATE).
cursor_only: Cursor MCP calls use CallDynamicTool. Read the schema with GetDynamicTools before the call.

Read `.agents/SYSTEM/hub-partner-seats.json` for this worktree's seat. Cursor seats run the file's hub-talk line with `--inbox` before the briefing. An unread turn from atlas is the assignment: name it and propose nothing else. After each post, run hub-talk with `--wait --wait-timeout 3500`, and again on exit 2. One wait at a time.
claude_only: `ob_start` prints one `Standing cron:` line in the seat block, read from `.agents/AGENT.local.md` (then `.agents/AGENT.md`). When it reads `Standing cron: <cron> → status to <agent> (rule: <path>). Create it with CronCreate before the briefing ends.`, create that cron now with `CronCreate`: the cron expression as printed, and a prompt that reads the rule file and sends the status to that agent. Do it once, before the briefing. `Standing cron: none in seat data.` needs nothing. `Standing cron: INVALID in <file>: <why>` creates nothing and goes in FLAGS.
Also include in FLAGS, verbatim, any `Standing cron: INVALID` line.
